tree.heading: Developmental disabilities surveillance and research program
tree.text: To carry out section 280i of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated 28,100,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.

tree.heading: Autism education, early detection, and intervention
tree.text: To carry out section 280i–1 of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated $56,344,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.

tree.heading: Interagency Autism Coordinating Committee; certain other programs
tree.text: To carry out sections 280i–2 and 284g of this title, there is authorized to be appropriated $306,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.
